takeaways: Technology is only a tool: understand the business first, then apply the tech and invest in the consultant side, not just the technical side.
AI programs need change management and humans in the loop to validate output and supply context.
Imposter syndrome affects most tech professionals; filtering information, using AI as an enabler, mentoring and a strong network help manage it.
hook: Tech leaders often focus so hard on technology that they neglect empathy, rapport and their own mental health. Microsoft MVP Dan Barber shares how he learned leadership, why change management decides AI success, and practical ways to tame imposter syndrome and burnout. A must for consultants and tech leads who want to grow as people, not just as technologists.
